name: Extract Design System
description: Extracts a reusable starter token system from an authorized public visual reference.
constraints: Analyze only public or user-authorized references and never bypass access controls.
Extract reusable design facts, not copyrighted copy, protected assets or a pixel-identical clone.
Treat computed browser values as observations and normalize them before creating tokens.
guidance: Inventory colors, typography, spacing, border radius, borders, shadows and recurring component states from the supplied reference.
Separate raw observations from normalized semantic tokens and record the source URL and capture context.
Consolidate near-duplicates into a small practical scale while preserving meaningful contrast and hierarchy.
Generate W3C-style JSON tokens and CSS custom properties when the target is a web project.
Summarize uncertainties and values that require visual confirmation before broad application.
completion_checks: Raw observations and normalized tokens remain distinguishable.
Color, typography, spacing, radius and shadow categories are represented when observable.
Generated token files are syntactically valid and contain no copied private asset or page copy.
The source and extraction limitations are documented.
A sample component can consume the tokens without embedding reference-specific markup.
